description: One fader working as a crossfader, an attenuator, an attenuverter or a manual DC offset

params.text: In the down position the signals at both inputs are inverted, and so is the DC offset generated when neither input is patched
Fades from the first input at the top to the second input at the bottom; with one signal patched it attenuates that signal down to 0V, and with neither patched it sets the level of a DC offset

inputs.text: The signal that passes with the fader at the top
The signal that passes with the fader at the bottom

outputs.text: The result of the fade, or a 10V DC offset at the top of the fader when neither input is patched, positive or negative according to the polarity switch
